newsitem.title: KYRGYZSTAN: Kyrgyz net grain harvest over 1 mln T, nearly done.
newsitem.headline: Kyrgyz net grain harvest over 1 mln T, nearly done.

text.p: Kyrgyzstan's net grain harvest is nearly completed with 1.14 million tonnes brought in as of October 1, a spokesman for the Central Asian republic's National Statistics Committee said on Tuesday.
"We have harvested 1,144,200 tonnes of grain from about 92 percent of the area sown," he said.
He said a total of 497,900 hectares had been sown with grains in the mountainous republic.
Of the total grain harvested, wheat accounted for 984,600 tonnes, the committee spokesman said. The original official 1996 target for wheat was 850,000 tonnes.

The committee has projected the 1996 total grain harvest at 1.3 million tonnes, above the 1995 harvest of 980,000 tonnes. Last month, Kyrgyz President Askar Akayev told parliament the 1996 harvest would satisfy the former Soviet republic's grain needs.
